title: How Many Stops?
short: Work out how many stops a job needs, and how much a palace of a given size holds.
trouble: Planning for exactly the number of items, with no spare stops for mistakes.

practice.q: A palace with 20 stops, 2 pictures per stop, 2 digits per picture. How many digits does it hold?
practice.title: Worked example

blocks.html: Capacity is simple arithmetic, and it saves surprises.
Holds = stops × pictures per stop × items per picture. Needs = items ÷ (pictures per stop × items per picture), rounded up.
